reviews.text: This was my first training session, and there was so much to learn, it was challenging. However, the instructor was excellent, so I enjoyed it.

I met you at Pomeranian Festival and received advice.

I feel like I can do it now!

I used the one-month daycare service.

They provided individualized care, and I was able to learn about my dog's personality and habits that I wouldn't have known at home. ✨
They kept a close eye on him, and I felt at ease knowing he could play safely with the other dogs!

I had been studying obedience training by watching YouTube and TikTok videos, but putting it into practice was often difficult as it didn't go as smoothly as the videos suggested. However, they taught me tips and even provided follow-up support by phone, which has allowed me to continue training at home.

I also requested a shampoo and grooming, and his fur has been fluffier than ever before…! 🫧
Thank you so much!

During the daycare, I, as the owner, experienced separation anxiety, so it would be even more reassuring if you could send photos and videos more frequently. 🥹

I was so grateful that you were able to accommodate my last-minute booking request, even though my elderly dog, May-chan, requires special care. I didn't have to cancel my plans, and I felt at ease leaving her in your care thanks to the thorough care and communication I received.

We've been using Dog Life's services since our dog was a puppy, when he turned three. During the training period, they taught us how to interact with him in a way that suited our family, taking into account his personality and how he would get along with our other dogs and children. They've continued to provide follow-up support and advice. Currently, we use their services for weekly daycare, grooming, boarding, and dog run events. They also advised us when our senior dog passed away in the spring.

The photos they always send us for updates are always wonderful, and that's one of the things we look forward to.

At a recent owner-participation pool event, we enjoyed playing in the pool and dog run with the daycare's dogs, their owners, and the staff, and also enjoyed socializing around a barbecue (more so than the owners!).

By using Dog Life's services, our dog has developed social skills, and so far, we haven't had any major problems with communication with other dogs, interacting with people, or being left alone.

Even in our city life, we want our dog to be able to live freely, yet respectfully, as a happy member of our family… We will continue to visit your services in the future.

This time, we had swimming lessons in the pool. The instructors were gentle and taught us to swim many times, and we were able to swim well. Thank you for letting us participate in such a wonderful event that both the dog and the owner were very happy with! 😊

I requested a 5-night, 6-day stay for my 20-year-old Toy Poodle.

They took very kind and excellent care of her. Thank you so much. I would definitely use your services again if the opportunity arises.

I was a little anxious about my child's first day at daycare and their overnight stay in a while, but the staff took excellent care of them, and I felt completely at ease leaving them there.

I would definitely like to use their services again.
Unlike many pet hotels that pile up cramped enclosures, this one provides a safe and comfortable environment for your pet. The pick-up and drop-off service is also very convenient. 🚗 …
